newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes up $8.50 on NYMEX strength.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes up $8.50 on NYMEX strength.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed $8.50 higher on Friday on the back of NYMEX gains built on forecasts of cold European and U.S. weather, traders said.
"It was a very strong, nice close, following (New York) heating up," a trader said. "It was a good move up, especially since the (gas oil) fundamentals in Europe don't look too clever."
January gas oil futures finished at $213.75, up from $212.00 in midafternoon. Much of the focus was on buying of the Jan/Feb spread, which grew $1.50 over the session to finish at $6.
January Brent stood 51 cents up at $23.03 per barrel.
Private forecasters WSC said western European temperatures would continue well below average for the time of year, and also saw below-average temeratures in the U.S. midwest next week.
"Gas oil got a boost from heat going over 70 cents, but this market is still treacherous," said Charles Gray of Prudential Bache Futures in London.

Gray said heavy oil price falls earlier this week had prompted increased domestic and retail buying of heating oil in Europe. He added that prices may have fallen too far, given that winter was only just starting.
